_README: Reference table for Russia's government-issued generic model charters
№411) — the boilerplate text a company adopts INSTEAD OF filing a
custom charter. A copy of the template's own text carries ZERO
entity-specific information (no names, no capital, no address, no
founder disclosure) — do not try to extract facts from it, and do not
attribute it to a single entity in sources.json's per-source 'entities'
list the way an actual company-specific Устав bundle is.
What IS evidentially useful: WHICH template number a specific entity
adopted, and WHEN (a registration-time choice, or a later switch away
from a custom charter). A switch to a generic template is itself a
fact worth recording on the entity — it's how a company stops
disclosing founders/capital in its own public charter text without
technically going dark. Record that fact on the entity (see
known_users below, cross-referenced from entities.json's own
